review: 701.48a-2: the Lesson-from-outside-the-game branch of 701.48a was left uncovered although Forge's learnLesson supports it through the sideboard; added a scenario with Environmental Sciences in the sideboard and an empty-sideboard contrast.
701.48a-1: forge_notes claimed the Lesson branch was unreachable in Forge; rewrote it to point to 701.48a-2.

scenarios.title: Learn lets the player discard a card to draw a card

setup.notes: A's sideboard is empty, so no Lesson card is available outside the game. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A casts Cram Session, tapping both Forests (the hybrid {B/G} is paid with Forest mana).
Both players pass; Cram Session resolves: A gains 4 life, then learns.
A chooses to discard Grizzly Bears to Learn.

variants.label: discard_draw
variants.expected: A's life is 24. Grizzly Bears moves from A's hand to A's graveyard and A draws Mountain from the top of the library. A's hand is [Mountain]; A's graveyard holds Grizzly Bears and Cram Session.

variants.label: empty_hand
variants.delta: A's hand holds only Cram Session, so after it is cast A has no other card to discard.
variants.expected: A's life is 24. A has no card to discard, so nothing is discarded and nothing is drawn. A's hand is empty and Mountain stays on top of A's library. No Lesson is fetched because A has none outside the game.

variants.label: declined
variants.delta: A chooses not to discard Grizzly Bears when Learn resolves.
variants.expected: A's life is 24. No card is discarded and none is drawn. Grizzly Bears stays in A's hand and Mountain stays on top of A's library. No Lesson is fetched because A has none outside the game.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's learnLesson offers sideboard Lessons and hand cards together; with an empty sideboard only the discard-and-draw branch and the no-op remain. The Lesson branch is 701.48a-2.

scenarios.title: Learn without a discard puts a Lesson from outside the game into the hand

setup.notes: A's sideboard holds Environmental Sciences (a Lesson) and nothing else. After Cram Session is cast A's hand is empty, so A cannot discard. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests. The sideboard is not a zone the scenario format lists.

decisions: A casts Cram Session, tapping both Forests (the hybrid {B/G} is paid with Forest mana).
Both players pass; Cram Session resolves: A gains 4 life, then learns.
A has no card to discard and chooses to reveal Environmental Sciences from the sideboard.

variants.label: lesson_available
variants.expected: A's life is 24. Environmental Sciences is revealed and moves from A's sideboard to A's hand. Nothing is discarded or drawn; Mountain stays on top of A's library.

variants.label: no_lesson
variants.expected: A's life is 24. No card moves to A's hand and nothing is discarded or drawn; A's hand is empty and Mountain stays on top of A's library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Player.learnLesson reads Lesson cards from the Sideboard zone; the match must be started with Environmental Sciences in A's sideboard.
